rows.bestow-choice-lets-an-aura-only-flash-gr: CR 601.3b: a player may consider the bestow choice when an effect lets Aura spells be cast as though they had flash, so Hopeful Eidolon may be cast for its bestow cost on the opponent's turn under Sigarda's Aid. Observed: the bestowed cast is not offered (only pass and concede), while the control scenario's plain Aura is cast at the same point.
